'''Ruth D. Etzioni''' is a biostatistician who develops statistical computer models to research cancer progression. She is the Rosalie and Harold Rea Brown endowed chair at the [[Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center]].

== Life ==
Etzioni completed a B.S. in statistics at the [[University of Cape Town]] in 1985.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Ruth Etzioni, Ph.D. |url=https://www.fredhutch.org/en/faculty-lab-directory/etzioni-ruth.html |access-date=2022-10-10 |website=Fred Hutch |language=en}}</ref> She earned a M.S. (1987) and Ph.D. (1990) in Statistics at [[Carnegie Mellon University]].<ref name=":0" /> She was a postdoctoral researcher in the department of biostatistics at the [[University of Washington]] from 1991 to 1992.<ref name=":0" />

Etzioni joined the faculty at the [[Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center]] in 1992 as an associate in the biostatistics program.<ref name=":0" /> Her research interests include the development and implementation of statistical methods for prostate cancer studies.<ref name=":0" /> She held multiple positions before her promotion to full member of the public health sciences division in 2002.<ref name=":0" /> Etzioni was elected a fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]] in April 2016.<ref name=":0" /> As of 2016, her research focuses on the development of statistical computer models to learn about the latent process of cancer progression from observed data on disease incidence and mortality.<ref>{{Cite news |date=November 4, 2016 |title=Etzioni to give next "Mind the Gap" seminar |pages=5 |work=[[NIH Record]] |url=https://nihrecord.nih.gov/sites/recordNIH/files/pdf/2016/NIH-Record-2016-11-04.pdf |access-date=2022-10-10}}{{PD-notice}}</ref> Etzioni became the inaugural recipient of the Rosalie and Harold Rea Brown endowed chair in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mapes |first=Diane |date=2020-10-07 |title=Dr. Ruth Etzioni receives Rosalie & Harold Rea Brown Endowed Chair |url=https://www.fredhutch.org/en/news/center-news/2020/10/biostatistician-dr-ruth-etzioni-receives-endowed-chair.html |access-date=2022-10-10 |website=Fred Hutch News Service |language=en}}</ref>
